selection_note: These tasks were used for protocol development; they are not unseen quality tests.
user: official user_simulator; same DeepSeek model and sampling settings across arms
stop_conditions: Before each agent, user or judge request, reserve conservative uncached-input plus max-output cost.
Stop if cumulative observed cost plus all outstanding reservations plus next reservation exceeds CNY 5.00.
Stop at 48 total paid requests; failed and interrupted attempts consume request count and reservations.
Unknown prices or missing usage stop the pilot; never record unknown cost as zero.
Any uncertain write or protocol violation stops that episode without tool replay.
Do not rerun failed episodes automatically or change frozen tasks, policy, DB or scorer.
preflight_required: Implement one episode-level outer request/tool budget for both arms, including per-turn legacy Loop resets.
Add shared agent+user+judge ledger; native LangGraph token accounting is not wired into official cost export yet.
Verify and freeze actual provider model, current official prices, exchange estimate and user-simulator config before authorization.
Freeze exact code SHA, dependency lock, original task/data/policy/source hashes and separate checkpoint path per episode.
This proposal is not authorization to send requests; current task is offline-only.
model_config_basis: Repository Settings defaults; provider availability and current prices must be verified before any paid run.
